mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_station_follow WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND station_id=#{stationId}
mapper.select: SELECT station_id FROM tb_station_follow WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY station_id
SELECT user_id FROM tb_station_follow WHERE station_id=#{stationId}

SELECT s.* FROM tb_station_slot s JOIN tb_station_follow f ON f.station_id=s.station_id WHERE f.user_id=#{userId} AND s.create_time>=f.create_time AND s.create_time>=DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY s.create_time DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT 1000
